newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp wholesale electric sales rising.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp wholesale electric sales rising.

text.p: PacifiCorp expects to ring up $1.4 billion in wholesale electric sales in 1997, nearly doubling 1996 revenues from the unregulated wholesale operations, company executives said on Thursday.

"In July and August, we'll be moving 9,000 megawatt hours on average in our unregulated business alone," Brian Sickels, vice president of PacifiCorp's global wholesale operations said in a briefing with reporters in Houston.

The Portland-based company expects to generate significant growth in its wholesale power business in the Midwest and eastern U.S. markets following its $437 million cash and debt acquisition of TPC Corp, the executives said.
"TPC is strong in the Midwest and East where we are not strong," said Don Furman, vice president of mergers and acquisitions.
PacifiCorp acquired TPC for its natural gas storage and gas and power marketing operations and is mulling the sale of TPC's gas processing and storage businesses, he said.
The acquisition is expected to be "mildly dilutive" to PacifiCorp earnings this year and "mildly accretive" next year, he said.
